errors.trafficStatsDescription: The traffic statistics component encountered an error and has been disabled to prevent crashes.

core.noSuchHost: Domain not found — check the subscription address and your internet connection
core.connectionRefused: The server refused the connection — it may be down or the port closed
core.connectionReset: The connection was cut mid-way — usually blocking or a network drop
core.timeout: No answer in time — the network is slow or the address is unreachable
core.unreachable: The network is unreachable — check your connection
core.portBusy: The port is already taken by another program — change it in the settings
core.permissionDenied: Not enough rights, or the system denied access — often a firewall or antivirus
core.tls: The certificate could not be verified — check the clock on this computer and the address
core.badConfig: The configuration could not be parsed — the panel sent a broken or unsupported file
core.unsupportedProxy: The configuration uses a protocol the core does not know — update the core or ask your provider
core.proxyNotFound: That server is no longer in the configuration — pick another one
core.tunFailed: The tunnel could not be raised — check the service and permissions
core.unauthorized: The panel rejected the subscription key — refresh the link in your account
core.forbidden: The panel denied access — the subscription may have expired or been blocked
core.notFound: The panel has no subscription at this address
core.serverError: The panel answered with an error of its own — try again later
core.chanBroken: The subscription response could not be decrypted — the connection was tampered with, or the provider turned the protection off
core.chanReplay: The subscription response does not answer our request — check the clock on this computer and try again
core.chanRefused: The middleware refused the secure request — the connection to it is being blocked, or the protection is off
core.chanBadUrl: This subscription address cannot be used with a secure connection

common.refreshFailed: Refresh failed; showing last loaded value
common.supportBundleCopied: Support report copied — subscription addresses and tokens are masked
common.logsExported: Log archive saved — subscription addresses and tokens are masked

config.failed: Subscription configuration validation failed. Please check the subscription configuration file; modifications have been rolled back.
config.bootFailed: Boot subscription configuration validation failed. Started with the default configuration; please check the subscription configuration file.
config.coreChangeFailed: Configuration validation failed when switching the kernel. Started with the default configuration; please check the subscription configuration file.
config.processTerminated: The validation process has been terminated.

merge.syntaxError: Merge file syntax error, changes reverted
merge.mappingError: Merge file mapping error, changes reverted
merge.keyError: Merge file key error, changes reverted
